name: Make a voice from another voice
objective: A new cloned voice (qwen3:<name>) made from a few seconds of another voice reading a sentence: one voice, then spoken in every language the cloning model knows. Only for a voice you have the right to use.

source.about: the machine whose speech module reads the sentence (any text-to-speech asset there; the voice itself is the field below)

keeper.about: the cloning model and the machine that keeps the new voice (the speech_torch module)

source_voice.label: Voice to copy
source_voice.hint: A voice id that machine's speech module serves (engine:name, e.g. kokoro:af_sky; a bare name is a Piper voice). Its /api/voices lists them.

name.label: Name of the new voice
name.hint: Letters, digits, _ and -. It becomes qwen3:<name>. A name that exists is refused: no voice is replaced.

text.label: What the source voice reads
text.default: The morning light came slowly over the hills, and by the time the kettle sang, the whole valley was awake and talking.
text.hint: One or two plain sentences, about 5 to 12 seconds spoken. The clone learns the voice from this recording and these exact words.
